Control.name: TemperCombat_RowTemplate
Control.OnMouseUp: TemperCombat.AddSelection( self, button, upInside, ctrl, alt, shift )

Control.name: TemperCombat_UnitRowTemplate
Control.OnMouseUp:
if button == MOUSE_BUTTON_INDEX_RIGHT then TemperCombat.UnitContextMenu( self, upInside ) else
TemperCombat.AddSelection( self, button, upInside, ctrl, alt, shift )
end

Control.name: TemperCombat_BuffRowTemplate

TemperCombat.AddSelection( self, button, upInside, ctrl, alt, shift )
end

Backdrop.name: $(parent)ResizeFrame
Backdrop.OnRectChanged: TemperCombat.NewSize(self, newLeft, newTop, newRight, newBottom, oldLeft, oldTop, oldRight, oldBottom)

Line.name: $(parent)Line
Line.OnInitialized: local color = ZO_ColorDef:New(GetString(SI_TEMPER_COMBAT_MAGICKA_COLOR)) self.color = color self:SetColor(color.r, color.g, color.b, color.a)

EditBox.name: $(parent)CopyPasteBox

Control.name: $(parent)Saved
Control.OnInitialized:
local scrollList = GetControl(self, "PanelScrollChild") scrollList:SetResizeToFitPadding(0, 20)
local label = GetControl(self, "HeaderName") label:SetText(GetString(SI_TEMPER_COMBAT_SAVED_FIGHTS))
self.numItems = 0

Backdrop.OnRectChanged: TemperCombat.NewSize(self, newLeft, newTop, newRight, newBottom, oldLeft, oldTop, oldRight, oldBottom)
